name: Chef Skinner Reading a Letter
look: A blurry still from Pixar's Ratatouille. Skinner, a scowling chef in a tall white toque, holds a lavender sheet of paper up under his nose and reads it with narrowed, suspicious eyes, while a warm brown restaurant interior blurs behind him.
use: Someone reading a message, note or document with deep suspicion. The caption says who is reading what, like a teacher checking a doctor's note or a parent reading a suspiciously good report card.
slots: who is reading and what they are reading (caption above)
examples: My teacher reading the permission slip my "mom" signed
Me reading the ingredients on a snack labeled "healthy"
